# American Library Association (ALA)

> > The American Library Association is the oldest and largest library association in the world, providing leadership for the development, promotion, and improvement of library and information services and the profession of librarianship.

ALA.org serves library professionals, educators, and advocates with resources on accredited MLIS programs, diversity initiatives including the Spectrum Scholarship Program, sustainability efforts through the Sustainability Round Table (SustainRT), and professional development opportunities. The site features blogs on equity, diversity, inclusion, self-care for librarians, and environmental stewardship in libraries.

## Key Topics

- ALA accreditation and MLIS programs
- Spectrum Scholarship Program
- Sustainability Round Table (SustainRT)
- Library diversity and inclusion initiatives
- Self-care for library professionals
- Library sustainability and environmental stewardship
- Emerging Leaders program
- Tribal libraries and indigenous services
- Equity, diversity, and inclusion (EDI)
- Professional development and fellowships
- Community-centered library services
- Workplace wellness in libraries
- International librarianship
- Member recognition and profiles

## ALA-Accredited Programs

- [Florida State University](https://www.ala.org/educationcareers/accreditedprograms/ALA-accredited-programs-directory/florida-state-university): ALA-accredited MLIS program at Florida State University School of Information
- [University of Kentucky](https://www.ala.org/educationcareers/accreditedprograms/ALA-accredited-programs-directory/university-kentucky): ALA-accredited MSLS program at University of Kentucky School of Information
- [University of Ottawa](https://www.ala.org/educationcareers/accreditedprograms/ALA-accredited-programs-directory/university-ottawa): ALA-accredited MIS program at University of Ottawa School of Information

## Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

- [Scholar Check-In: "How are you currently practicing self-care?"](https://www.ala.org/advocacy/spectrum/check-in-self-care): Spectrum Scholars share self-care practices during COVID-19 and racial trauma
- [Every Voice Matters: The Process of Building a Library Values Statement](https://www.ala.org/advocacy/diversity/odlos-blog/every-voice-matters): UTC Library creates EDI values statement through facilitated staff process
- [Meet AILA's 2018 Emerging Leaders Group and Learn about the Tribal Libraries Directory](https://www.ala.org/advocacy/diversity/odlos-blog/2018-Emerging-Leaders-Tribal-Libraries-Directory): AILA's 2018 Emerging Leaders create digital resource map for tribal libraries
- [Beep Beep: Creating Objective Criteria for Choosing Bookmobile Stops](https://www.ala.org/advocacy/diversity/odlos-blog/beep-beep): Arapahoe Libraries develops decision matrix for equitable bookmobile stops
- [Q&A with Priya Charry: Community work and "jugaad"](https://www.ala.org/advocacy/spectrum/qa-priya-charry): Interview with 2015-2016 Spectrum Scholar Priya Charry on her fellowship work
- [Self-Care for Librarians: Journaling](https://www.ala.org/advocacy/diversity/odlos-blog/self-care-journaling): Librarian discusses journaling as self-care practice for library professionals

## Sustainability and Environmental Initiatives

- [Getting Unstuck So You Can "Get Sustainability Done"](https://www.ala.org/sustainrt/getting-unstuck-so-you-can-get-sustainability-done): David Seldon reflects on advancing sustainability work in libraries
- [Conference Report: Libraries and Archives in the Anthropocene](https://www.ala.org/sustainrt/Conference-Report-Libraries-and-Archives-in-the-Anthropocene): Amy Brunvand reports on NYU's Libraries and Archives in Anthropocene conference
- [Picture Book Picks for Earth Month and Beyond](https://www.ala.org/sustainrt/picture-book-picks-earth-month-and-beyond): Environmental picture book recommendations for Earth Month storytimes
- [On Hope, Civilization, and Walking Blind](https://www.ala.org/sustainrt/On-Hope-Civilization-and-Walking-Blind): Reflections on climate anxiety, hope, and civilization's future
- [Call for Nominations: SustainRT Citation for Wellness in the Workplace](https://www.ala.org/sustainrt/call-nominations-sustainrt-citation-wellness-workplace): Nomination call for SustainRT workplace wellness citation award

## Member Profiles and Recognition

- [Asa L. Heyward named Senior Librarian of Teen Services](https://www.ala.org/advocacy/spectrum/asa-l-heyward-named-senior-librarian-teen-services): Spectrum Scholar Asa Heyward appointed to Suffolk Public Library teen services
- [Welcome New SustainRT Steering Committee Members!](https://www.ala.org/sustainrt/welcome-new-sustainrt-steering-committee-members): SustainRT announces new steering committee members and committee chairs
- [Member Monday: Jennifer Ferriss](https://www.ala.org/sustainrt/member-monday-jennifer-ferriss): Member Monday profile featuring Jennifer Ferriss from Saratoga Springs Library
- [Member Monday: Casey Conlin](https://www.ala.org/sustainrt/member-monday-casey-conlin): Member Monday profile featuring Casey Conlin from Mid-Hudson Library System
